features: 🎵 Trusted Tronica Performance – Made for Indian Homes Tronica is a household name across India, known for delivering high-performance audio systems. With a legacy of quality and innovation, Tronica products are built to meet the evolving needs of Indian consumers who expect durable and powerful sound experiences.

🎬 Bluetooth Home Cinema with Smart TV Compatibility Transform your living room into a home theatre by pairing JUDWAA with your Bluetooth-enabled Smart TV. Enjoy immersive sound for movies, music, and shows with this proudly Made in India speaker tower set designed for cinematic impact.

🎧 Multi-Input Support: FM, USB, SD, AUX, Guitar & MIC Play your favorite audio from any source. JUDWAA supports Bluetooth, USB, SD Card, FM Radio, AUX input, Mobile, Guitar, and Wired Microphone, offering complete plug-and-play flexibility for home entertainment and musical instruments.

🎮 Smart Remote Control for Effortless Access Control your music, volume, input modes, and more with the included full-function smart remote. Sit back and switch between your preferred playback options from anywhere in the room—making your experience truly wireless and easy.

🔊 Dual Tower Setup – 100W Peak with Wooden Build The JUDWAA model features two elegant 8mm wooden towers, each equipped with a 6-inch woofer and two 4-inch drivers. Together they produce a rich 100W peak power output, delivering balanced bass and crisp treble in a classy home audio package.

Designed to deliver rich sound performance at an accessible price, this pair of floor-standing tower speakers offers clarity across low, mid, and high frequencies. From soft dialogue to dynamic action scenes, JUDWAA enhances movies, TV shows, music, and everyday entertainment with consistent and detailed sound output. The Premium Series JUDWAA features a sleek black ash vinyl finish that blends effortlessly with modern home décor. Built around TRONICA’s commitment to quality and affordability, these speakers combine reliable audio performance with a refined design suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, and entertainment spaces. This high-efficiency tower speaker system is equipped with a dynamically balanced woofer and dual passive radiators, delivering smooth mid-range response and deep, controlled bass. The wide soundstage creates an immersive listening experience, helping bring your content to life without distortion at regular listening levels.
